title: THE VOICE ON 14 MEGACYCLES
beat: Valya hears the mayday nobody official will acknowledge and logs it against orders.
cliffhanger: Korabelnikov demands her logbook — the page is already missing.

title: THE MISSING PAGE
beat: Flashback to how the page vanished: Valya's own supervisor took it, on orders from Moscow.
cliffhanger: The supervisor is found dead at his desk, headphones still on.

title: TWO TAPES
beat: Valya makes a private copy of the mayday tape; the American voice says coordinates that match a cosmonaut who never flew.
cliffhanger: The second tape is gone from her hiding spot — and a second headset is warm.

title: PAPERWORK NIGHT
beat: A slow night of routine reports and tea in the break room; Valya files forms and misses her family.
cliffhanger: She files the last form and goes to sleep.
